content: EBYTE E32 series (incl. E32-900T30D, SX1276-based UART LoRa) has NO RSSI or SNR readout capability. Two independent authoritative sources: Renzo Mischianti (author of the EBYTE E32 Arduino library): 'no E32 can't give RSSI, if you need It you can use E22'; Wolles Elektronikkiste comparative guide: 'the RSSI function is not available on the E32 modules' / 'enableRSSI and enableLBT settings are not available on the E32 modules'. RSSI support exists only on E22/E220 series. Apparent 'C0 C1 C5' RSSI command references found in search results are E22/E220 commands misattributed to E32 by summarizers. Signal-quality monitoring on an E32 base must be derived from protocol-level metrics (beacon seq-gap loss rate, ACK ratios, retransmission pass counts).
